title: Symmetric Bounded Indistinguishability: Hypergeometric Smoothing and Hahn Polynomials
summary: A pair of probability distributions over $\{0,1\}^n$ is said to be $(k,δ)$-wise indistinguishable if all of the size $k$ marginals are within statistical distance at most $δ$. Previous works introduce this concept and study how far apart $t$-wise marginals can be under an assumption of $(k,δ)$-wise indistinguishability. We consider symmetric distributions and obtain a new upper bound that unifies and improves previous bounds and applies across a wider range of parameters.
